system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points
  • Ritualism rituals

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Source: League homebrew Ritualist.)

RITUALIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000277]{Spellcasting Assistant} 【Max SL 3】

When you take the Assist action on an ally's spell, that spell gains: +2 to the caster's Magic Check (SL1); the spell deals or heals +(SL × 5) (SL2); the spell's MP cost is reduced by (SL × 5) (SL3). All unlocked benefits apply at the appropriate SL.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000278]{Accelerate Ritual} 【Max SL 3】

When working on a ritual clock, spend (SL × 5) MP to mark an additional segment beyond the action's normal yield.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000279]{Magical Countermeasures} 【Max SL 3】

Reaction: spend (SL × 10) MP. Remove up to (SL) willing creatures from the target list of a hostile spell before it resolves. Cannot remove the caster themselves.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000280]{Ritualistic Efficiency} 【Max SL 2】

You gain +(SL) on all ritual checks. The zenit cost of any ritual you participate in is reduced by (SL × 50), minimum 0.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000281]{Loyal Supporter} 【Max SL 5】

When you assist an ally's check (any type), your bonus is increased by +1 per 3 points by which your result exceeds the difficulty (max bonus +(SL)).
